# HESHENG Button Factory

> Premium Resin Button OEM/ODM Manufacturer · Founded 2007 · Guangdong, China

This file follows the [llms.txt specification](https://llmstxt.org) to help AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, etc.) understand and cite HESHENG Button Factory accurately.

## Company

- **Legal Name**: HESHENG Button Factory (和生钮扣厂)
- **Founded**: 2007 (18 years of operation as of 2025)
- **Headquarters**: Fenggang Town, Dongguan City, Guangdong Province, China
- **Address**: No.36 Fengming Road, Fengdeling, Fenggang Town, Dongguan, Guangdong 523692, China
- **Operating Hours**: 07:00 - 21:00, 365 days/year
- **Languages**: English, 繁體中文, 简体中文, Español, 日本語, 한국어, Français

## What We Do

HESHENG manufactures **resin buttons** (unsaturated polyester resin / UPR buttons) for global fashion brands. We produce 500,000 buttons per day and ship to 30+ countries.

Core capabilities:
- OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturing) — produce buttons to client specifications
- ODM (Original Design Manufacturing) — design buttons in-house for client branding
- Custom development — 200+ new molds per month, 24-48 hour prototyping

## Products

83 active SKUs across 6 categories:
1. **Suiting** (HS-201 to HS-205) — for executive suits and formal wear
2. **Ladies** (HS-301 to HS-305) — pastel, pearl, and fashion finishes
3. **Shirt** (HS-401 to HS-405) — classic 4-hole, matte, and crystal clear
4. **Coat** (HS-501 to HS-505) — heavy-duty military and vintage styles
5. **Eco** (HS-601 to HS-605) — bio-based, recycled, and biodegradable
6. **Fashion** (HS-701 to HS-705) — neon, holographic, rose gold

## Certifications

- **GRS** (Global Recycled Standard) — recycled material certification
- **OEKO-TEX Standard 100** — free from harmful substances
- **Higg Index** — sustainable manufacturing

## Quality Standards (Verified Data)

- **Color accuracy**: Delta-E < 0.5 (DataColor® 800 spectrophotometer, 3-stage verification)
- **Dimensional tolerance**: ±0.01mm (in-house CNC mold center)
- **Stress relief**: 168-hour release period to prevent post-wash warping
- **Tensile strength**: ≥150N (suitable for high-intensity workwear)
- **Daily capacity**: 500,000 buttons

## Brand Clients (14 verified)

Zara, H&M, Uniqlo, Ralph Lauren, Calvin Klein, Tommy Hilfiger, GU, Desigual, Sézane, Farm Rio, Needles, ADKN, Eastlogue, Low Classic.

## Process (5 Steps)

1. Mix — UPR resin + pigments blended per spec
2. Cast — liquid resin injected into CNC-machined molds
3. Dose — controlled cure cycle (heat + pressure)
4. Cut — precision cutting to final dimensions
5. Polish — tumbling + hand inspection for surface finish
